mapper.select: SELECT * FROM supplier_sku WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM supplier_sku WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT ss.* FROM supplier_sku ss JOIN supplier s ON s.id = ss.supplier_id JOIN product_sku sku ON sku.id = ss.sku_id JOIN product_spu spu ON spu.id = sku.spu_id WHERE ss.sku_id = #{skuId} AND ss.status = 'ENABLED' AND ss.deleted = FALSE AND s.status = 'ENABLED' AND s.deleted = FALSE AND sku.status = 'ON_SHELF' AND sku.deleted = FALSE AND spu.status = 'ON_SHELF' AND spu.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY ss.is_default DESC, ss.id
mapper.update: UPDATE supplier_sku SET deleted = TRUE, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = 'SYSTEM' WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = FALSE
